title: feat(desktop): the bubble leaves the recording when the face is recorded apart, and Share includes it (NIW2-576)
body:
PR 6, the last of the webcam-track stack ([#437 design](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/437) → [#441 recorder](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/441) → [#442 vault](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/442) → [#443 scene](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/443) → [#444 preview](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/444) → [#445 export](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/445) → this). Linear [NIW2-576](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-576), parent [NIW2-565](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-565). Base: `feature/niw2-575-webcam-export`.

> [!WARNING]
> **Do not merge before the exclusion spike passes.** This PR removes the camera bubble from the screen capture (Plan A, ADR 0032). The owner has **not** yet run Task 0 ([#440](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/440)), which checks that the bubble leaves the recording without a blank or black patch. If Task 0 fails, this PR's protection change is replaced by Plan B. #441–#445 can merge without this one: the face then stays burned in, as today, while the editor and exports also get the separate layer.

## What this does

1. **Share** now composes the webcam at the layout it was recorded with.
2. **The bubble leaves the screen capture**, but only while the take is actually recording a webcam file. In every other case it stays in the capture, burned in as before, so a take never ends without a face because of this change. "Every other case" means: the camera turned on mid-take, the camera failing to open, main failing to create the webcam session, and Windows before 10 2004.
3. **Docs are marked "ready to validate, owner QA pending"**, and nothing claims the spike passed.

## Why

This is the last step of the stack. Until the bubble leaves the capture, the editor shows the face twice: once as the layer, once burned into the zoomed screen.

## What changes for you

- **The camera bubble no longer appears in recordings** (macOS, and Windows 10 2004+) when the take records a webcam file. Your face comes from the webcam layer in the editor, exports and Share.
- **The bubble is still recorded as part of the screen** when the camera is off at the start and turned on mid-take, when the camera can't be opened, or on older Windows.
- **A new notice after a take:** "The camera wasn't available, so your face was recorded in the screen instead."
- **A take does not start** if main cannot confirm the camera fallback. This only happens if main is gone; you get the existing start error with retry.
- **Share of a camera-on recording includes the face.** Its file is reused by the next Share. Old faceless Share files are not reused for these recordings.
- **An export that lost its webcam** (missing file or decode error) is not offered for reuse later.

## What to review

1. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/bubble-protection.ts:17`: the rule.** The bubble is protected when no take is active, or when the active take records a live webcam file. Only the newest take counts; stale ids are ignored. Decide whether this rule is what you want.
2. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:330`: order of operations.** The webcam is settled before the screen is requested, so protection is fixed before the capture stream starts. That is when the Electron/SCK exclusion list is read. A rejected report fails the start.
3. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/camera-bubble-window.ts:104` and `:136`: protected at creation, flipped live by `applyProtection`.** A live flip after the stream started (an unplugged camera, a failed webcam write) is best effort and unverified until spike rows 4 and 5.
4. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:395`: the new `purpose` argument.** Export writer sessions pass `"export"` and are excluded from protection bookkeeping (Codex C1). The default is `"take"`.
5. **`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-reuse.ts:81` and `:94`: `wholeFingerprint` and `facelessFingerprint`.**

**Safe to skim:** the IPC type and preload plumbing, the i18n pair for the notice, the docs status flips (`backlog/index.mdx` is about 224 lines only because oxfmt realigned the table), and the test fakes.

## Proof

| Criterion (NIW2-576) | What was done | How to check it | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Share composes the webcam at the recorded layout; `whole:<hash>`; a second Share reuses it; an edited export does not | `initialScene(duration, webcam)` and `webcamTrack` in Share; `wholeFingerprint` | `export-reuse.test.ts`, `share-recording.test.tsx` (exact seeded hash) | Unit tests pass. **Real Share: not verified** |
| The bubble is content-protected from creation; on Windows < 10 2004 the legacy path stays | Protected at creation while the rule allows it; the old-Windows refusal is marked | `camera-bubble-window.test.ts`, `bubble-protection.test.ts`, `recording-hub.test.ts` ("whether the bubble leaves the capture", old Windows) | Unit tests pass. **On real capture: pending Task 0 (#440)** |
| (Review) A take never loses the face because of protection: camera on mid-take, camera unavailable, session refused, export in the background | `BubbleProtection`, `recording:webcam-ended`, webcam settled before the screen, `purpose` | Engine, store and hub tests for each path (F1, F2, N1, N2, C1, C2) | Unit tests pass |
| The comment in `camera-bubble-window.ts` and the docs are updated | Comments rewritten; spec, ADRs and backlog marked "owner QA pending" | Read the files | Done. The hub `desktop/media-pipeline` page is **not** updated (the repo's matching reference page is legacy Spanish) |
| Spec, ADR 0032/0033 statuses and backlog row updated to 🟢 | Flipped honestly: Proposed, implemented, owner QA pending | `backlog/webcam-track.md`, ADR Status rows | Done |
| check-types, lint and tests pass; owner QA | — | `vitest run`; pre-push `verify:local` | exit 0, 325 files, 3317 tests; pre-push passed. **Owner QA pending** |

## Decisions

- **Protection follows the take's webcam file, not only the OS capability** (review F1). Options: protect always (fails when the camera is turned on mid-take), or protect only while a webcam file is being recorded. Taken: the second. Losing the face is worse than seeing it twice.
- **The webcam is settled before the screen is requested** (F2). This costs at most the webcam's 3 s open deadline before capture, and the countdown hides it.
- **The notice is shown after the take saves**, because the main window, where toasts live, is hidden during a take.
- **A failed report to main fails the take start** (Codex C2) instead of recording a take that might have no face.
- **Old Windows signals "no webcam track" by refusing the session**, marked `[webcam:unsupported]` (F4 kept as is; a capability flag is a follow-up).
- **A faceless export gets plain `whole` (Share) or no fingerprint (editor)** (F3), so it is never reused as if it had the face.
- **ADRs stay "Proposed — implemented, owner QA pending"**, not Accepted, until the spike and QA pass.

## Review ledger

> [!CAUTION]
> **Risk: high.** Changes a main-process window flag that decides what every screen recording contains (`camera-bubble-window.ts`, the new `bubble-protection.ts`), recording session creation and a new IPC in `recording-hub.ts`, and the Share export fingerprint.

| id | severity | outcome |

| F2 | should | fixed: 7ba61f47 (webcam settled before the screen; main unprotects first; notice) |
| F3 | nit | fixed: 60db2c02 (faceless exports are not offered for reuse) |
| F5 | nit | fixed: fedc0995 (exact seeded fingerprint in the Share test) |
| N1 | nit | fixed: 434f998f (a failed webcam write puts the bubble back in the capture, best effort) |
| N2 | nit | fixed: c686aa9b (a refused webcam session on a current OS shows the notice) |
| C1 (Codex) | should | fixed: cb7d80ff (export sessions are excluded from protection bookkeeping) |
| C2 (Codex) | should | fixed: 5269f07e (an unconfirmed fallback fails the start) |
| F4 | nit | declined, follow-up: expose a capability flag instead of a refusal on old Windows; rename `fullDisplayBorderAllowed` |
| R1 | nit | declined, follow-up: make `purpose` required, and pass `"take"` explicitly from the recorder |

Rounds: 3 with Opus 5.5 (fresh-context reviewer) and 2 with Codex (cross-provider: CHANGES C1/C2, then APPROVE). Budget 5, all used.
**Verdict for 5269f07e (patch-id d609752bb92c): approved, only nits remain.**

### Residual risk (documented, not fixed)

Two ways a take can still end with no face anywhere:

1. **The webcam is lost after the capture started** (unplugged, encoder failure, output failing to start, or a failed write). The bubble is unprotected live, but whether a running ScreenCaptureKit stream then includes it is unverified. Spike rows 4 and 5 answer this.
2. **The webcam file fails to finalize at stop.** Nothing signals it during the take, so the bubble stayed protected.

There is also a pre-existing issue outside this PR: a failed export screen write still sends "stop" to the recorder.

## Checks

- `cd apps/kaipu-record && vitest run`: exit 0, 325 files, 3317 tests passed (on 5269f07e).
- Pre-push `verify:local` (lint, oxfmt, build, check-types): passed on push.

## Manual verification

This is owner QA, and it depends on Task 0. Agents do not run Electron on the owner's machine.

**Setup:** `git checkout feature/niw2-576-webcam-share-protect && bun install && bun run dev`.

**1. Task 0 first** ([#440](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/440)): run its matrix. If any Mac row shows a patch, or the bubble is captured, stop here; this PR waits for Plan B.

**2. Camera on from the start**
- Record 10 s, then open the raw file in QuickTime.
- Expect: no bubble in the screen pixels.
- In the editor, expect: the face as a layer, once.

**3. Camera turned on mid-take**
- Start with the camera off, turn it on 3 s in, and stop.
- Expect: the bubble is burned into the screen from 3 s on (the legacy path), and there is no webcam layer.
- Broken if: the face is nowhere.

**4. Camera unavailable**
- Hold the camera in another app (or deny it), then record with the camera on.
- Expect: after the take, the notice "The camera wasn't available…", and the bubble burned into the screen.

**5. Export during a take**
- Start an export, and record while it runs.
- Expect: the bubble behaves as in step 2 or 3, unaffected by the export.

**6. Share**
- Share a camera-on recording.
- Expect: the face in the shared file. Share again and expect "already exported". Edit the recording, Share from the editor, and expect a new file.

## What I did not verify

- Anything on a real device. The exclusion itself is Task 0, and the live unprotect is spike rows 4 and 5.
- Windows, old or new.
- How the post-take notice looks.
